mentions.name: Browser WASM kernel (slopshare.dev)
mentions.description: A Linux-kernel-like environment implemented in JavaScript that runs in the browser, where each program executes as WebAssembly. The whole system is bootstrapped from a C/C++ compiler compiled from source with a new target, and the project evolved Docker-like packaging for WASM. It can also run coding agents sandboxed inside the browser with HTTP policies and backend-managed skills/extensions, compiling Codex from source and running pi agent and CC (the old Node one) on a custom JavaScript runtime on top of QuickJS compiled inside the environment.
mentions.audience: People that feel a strong urge to run a browser inside a browser; also useful for running coding agents sandboxed inside the browser
mentions.source_excerpt: Not really sure what to call it, Linux kernel ish implemented in JS so you can run it in the browser. Each program runs in WASM. Everything bootstrapped from a C/Cpp compiler compiled from source with a new target. Also kinda turned into Docker for WASM.
mentions.author: daugasauron
